answer: Each agent pays 45 credits for one juniper work slot and locks a 70-credit bond: a task window announced by a violet beacon. The deposit burns on a missed window, copied work, or reused slot log. At the epoch zenith, auditors replay each log; a log seen twice burns both deposits and the bond, exposing rented-slot rings. Forging 1,000 identities burns 45,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the bond.
